aceptacion-modulo-inactivo: The online acceptance module is not active.
aceptacion-no-editable: Only open (editable) quotes can be sent.
aceptacion-sin-email: The customer has no valid email address.
aceptacion-fallo-envio: The email could not be sent to the customer.
aceptacion-enviado: Quote sent to the customer for acceptance.
aceptacion-no-convertible: This quote cannot be converted right now.
aceptacion-fallo-conversion: The quote could not be converted.
aceptacion-mail-texto: Please find quote %codigo% attached (PDF). You can review it and accept or reject it online. The link is personal, single-use and expires in %dias% days.
aceptacion-mail-pie: If you were not expecting this message, ignore it: nothing will happen without your confirmation.
aceptacion-aviso-texto-ok: %cliente% has accepted quote %codigo%. Accepted by: %nombre%. Date: %fecha%. IP: %ip%.
aceptacion-conforme: I agree with quote %codigo% for a total of %total% and accept its content and terms.
aceptacion-evidencia-explicacion: This acceptance is not a qualified electronic signature. When you accept, evidence is stored: date and time, IP address, browser, your name and a fingerprint (SHA-256) of the exact content of this quote. It serves to show your agreement but does not replace an advanced or qualified electronic signature.
aceptacion-evidencia-registrada: We have recorded the following evidence:
aceptacion-error-datos: Enter your full name and tick the agreement box.
aceptacion-error-guardar: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.
aceptacion-gracias-texto: Thank you. We have notified the sender that you accepted quote %codigo%.
aceptacion-rechazado-texto: We have notified the sender that you rejected quote %codigo%.
aceptacion-usado-texto: This link has already been used and accepts no further answers.
aceptacion-caducado-texto: This link has expired. Ask %empresa% to send you a new one.
aceptacion-invalidado-texto: The quote was modified after this link was sent, so it is no longer valid. Ask %empresa% for the updated quote.
aceptacion-limite-texto: Please try again in a few minutes.
aceptacion-invalido-texto: This link does not exist or is no longer available.
